title: docs(guide),console: write the react-tier ListView binding as data + type, not the retired objectName / viewType
body:
Fixes #8510
Clause-②: no

The react-tier ListView block's `objectName` / `viewType` aliases are retired from the published contract (objectstack#14791, ruling B, no deprecation window). This PR rewrites every in-repo author site of those spellings to the contract's only spelling, `data={{ provider: 'object', object: '…' }}` for the binding and `type` for the visualization, on the ListView block only.

## Premise check (the director seat's first act on claim)

The retirement ships in what this repo installs. After `pnpm install` in this worktree, `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/lint` both resolve to `17.4.0` (the lockfile's only resolution for each). Both packages' `17.4.0` CHANGELOG sections name `react-prop-retired`. The installed lint exports `REACT_PROP_RETIRED = "react-prop-retired"` and fires it from `validateReactPageProps`. The installed `REACT_BLOCKS` ListView entry declares neither alias: its `dataProps` and `interactions` carry `data` and `type`, and the only `objectName` / `viewType` text left in the entry is the summary sentence saying they are retired.

## Sites rewritten

`content/docs/guide/react-pages.md`, five sites (the card named four; the fifth is a census hit):

1. `kind:'react'` section, the worked JSON page's `source` string: ListView `objectName=\"showcase_project\"` becomes `data={{ provider: 'object', object: 'showcase_project' }}`.
2. **Census hit, not in the card:** the "Written out, that `source` is:" JSX block right below it. It is the same source on several lines and wrote `objectName="showcase_project"` on its own line, so leaving it would contradict the rewritten JSON. It post-dates the card's census.
3. "Two tiers" prose: a kanban / calendar / gantt / timeline / map of an object is now `ListView type="kanban" …` (was `viewType="kanban"`). The sentence's meaning is unchanged.
4. The `RecordRelatedList` replacement row keeps the related-list shape: `ListView data={{ provider: 'object', object: 'child_object' }} filters={['lookup_field', '=', parentId]}`.
5. "Blocks take flat props" sample: `ListView data={{ provider: 'object', object: 'showcase_project' }} fields={['name', 'status']} pagination={{ pageSize: 25 }}`.

`apps/console/src/sdui-workbench-preview.tsx`: the `crm_workbench` react page source's ListView, `objectName="showcase_project"` becomes `data={{ provider: 'object', object: 'showcase_project' }}`.

Out of scope and untouched, per the card: ObjectForm's own `objectName`, the `record:*` blocks' prose, `Block type="object-tree" objectName=…`, the metadata-tier `objectName` the host stamps, and the component-schema type `ListViewSchema['viewType']` in `packages/plugin-list/README.md`.

Census method: a `git grep` for the ListView JSX opening tag over `HEAD` in `content/docs/**` and `apps/**`, every hit read by hand. Live control: all five of the card's sites hit. Only the six sites above write a retired prop on a react-tier ListView.

## Proof

**The installed validator, before and after.** A one-time probe runs `validateReactPageProps` from the installed `@objectstack/lint@17.4.0` over the preview's page source (cooked), the doc's JSON page, its written-out copy, and the three inline doc snippets. The snippet's `…` elision is filled with a data binding, so the only variable is the retired prop.

- base `f5178a272`: 6 findings, all `react-prop-retired` (`objectName` x5, `viewType` x1).
- head `1bc5466b5`: 0 findings of any rule.

**The preview still renders `showcase_project`.** A new pin, `apps/console/src/__tests__/sdui-workbench-preview-listview-binding-8510.test.tsx`, pulls the `crm_workbench` source out through the shared preview extractor (`helpers/preview-page-sources.ts`). It mounts that source through the real `kind:'react'` tier and the real `list-view`.

- ListView hands its view `schema.objectName === 'showcase_project'`. It calls `getObjectSchema('showcase_project')`, and it queries `showcase_project` selecting the preview's columns. That query is distinct from the page's own `{ $top: 200 }` stats query.
- Control: the same source with the `data` binding stripped. Once ListView reports `data-state="idle"`, neither `getObjectSchema` nor any non-stats `find` has happened.
- `validateReactPageProps` finds no `react-prop-retired` on any preview page. Control: with the retired spelling put back, it yields exactly `[react-prop-retired]`.

**Ablation (one-time, not kept).** Predicted before running: disabling the `data.provider === 'object'` leg in `normalizeListViewSchema` turns only the positive render case red. Observed: `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`. The failing case is "renders the ListView bound to showcase_project through the data-source fold", because the view is never handed a bound object. The strip control and both lint cases stay green.

- The mutation landed by anchor: anchor count 1, marker count 1, 2 diff lines.
- It was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and the restore is proven by a blob hash equal to HEAD's.
- `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` resolve to `src` in the console project, so no rebuild was involved.

## Gates (local, at `1bc5466b5`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/`: Test Files 117 passed (117), Tests 1277 passed (1277). 117 is the count of tracked console test files, the pin included.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'`. Its first run flagged the new test file (an unused import, since removed), so it covers that file.
- eslint over the two touched `.tsx` files: 0 errors. The pin has 0 warnings. The preview's 7 `no-explicit-any` warnings are on untouched lines (7 at base too).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` OK. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` OK (empty-frontmatter declaration). `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: exit 0. It lists 5 pending changesets that name a touched file; each was read and none is falsified.
- Docs gates, all exit 0: `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-snippets` (674/674 judged, 0 failed, after its own `--build-filter` build), `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `docs:check-links`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:docs-route-closure`.
- NOT MEASURED: a grep of a built console `dist` for the preview. Reason: no built console exists here, and a full console build is out of proportion for this check. The reading is static instead: the console's Vite `rollupOptions` declares no `input` (single entry `index.html`), and the preview module's only importer is `apps/console/sdui-workbench-preview.html`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/8510-react-listview-spelling.md`, with an empty frontmatter (releases nothing). The gate counts `apps/console/src/**`, but the preview is a dev-server-only harness, and the rest of the change is a test and docs.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's second half is untouched because it is "Not decided here". `packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx` still declares `objectName` (required) and `viewType` as `inputs` of `list-view` and of its `list` alias, plus `defaultProps` `objectName: ''` / `viewType: 'grid'`. This is reported to the dispatch seat.
- Three test fixtures in `packages/components` still mount a react page whose ListView writes `objectName="showcase_project"`: `react-page-adapter.test.tsx`, and `react-page-scope.test.tsx` twice. They exercise scope and adapter plumbing, which renders either spelling. They sit outside the census the card set (`content/docs/**`, `apps/**`). Noted, not filed.
- The claim's file surface named the four doc sites "only". The fifth (the written-out copy) was added under the dispatch's census instruction, because leaving it would contradict the rewritten JSON just above it.
